title: Aeliya hai ali
body:
ali aeliya hai ali
<<DIVIDER>>
wo faqre do aalam wo noore mujassam
ali haq ka mehrab ali dam hama dam
ali aulia hai ali aulia hai ali aeliya hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo haq ki taraf hai namazon ki saf hai
wo shaahe najaf hai wo deen ka sharaf hai
wo haajat rawa hai wo haajat rawa hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali raahe mushkil ali haq ki manzil
ali deen e kaamil ali shamme mehfil
khuda ki ataa hai khuda ki ataa hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo husne payambar wo mehwe munawar
shuja'at ka paikar wo fattahe khyber
shahe la fata hai shahe la fata hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali mera qibla ali mera kaaba
ali mera maula ali mera aaqa
wo mushkil kusha hai wo mushkil kusha hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shabbir o shabbar chale peet'te sar
uthi binte hyder giri sar se chadar
haram berida hai haram berida hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
